name: Thurston County, WA
findings: Thurston County has 893 nonprofit organizations. 451 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 360 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Thurston County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
